scope: Independent CPU-only source review and executed VM probes. No browser, GPU, or build was run by this reviewer. Runtime evidence below was read directly from root-run ordinary-input evidence files.
status: No new actionable P1/P2 found in the reviewed scalar-motion and Space-chord integrations.

rootCause.old: Every render frame derived velocity from the latest pointer position, capped it to 18, then immediately mapped its magnitude to the scatter target. Frames with no new pointer sample mapped to zero; final scatter smoothing preserved the event duty cycle instead of continuous travelled speed.
rootCause.controlledExample: At 60 Hz RAF and 20 Hz pointer sampling, fast movement produced 18,0,0 velocity magnitude and 1,0,0 targets; steady scatter oscillated about 0.3125–0.3547.
rootCause.fix: Integrate the unsigned, uncapped raw distance/dt scalar using exponential rate 8, then clamp the integrated energy to 18. Keep the signed direction vector, particle-force cap, strength, and release decay separate. First-position and dt=0 samples establish the baseline; inactive and cancellation reset energy.
rootCause.rejectedAlternatives: Peak-holding a per-frame speed spike can misclassify genuinely slow sparse input; signed vector averaging cancels direction reversals.

red.baseline: A valid exported helper implementing the old frame-local capped scalar, not a missing import.
